arabic_title: دُعَاؤُهُ إذا نَظَرَ الى السَّحابِ و البَرقِ و عِنْدَ سَمَاعِ الرَّعْدِ
english_title: 36. When he saw Clouds and Lightening and heard the Thunder

phrases.arabic: أَللَّهُمَّ إنَّ هذَيْن آيَتَانِ مِنْ آياتِكَ،
phrases.english: 1.O God, these are two of Your signs
2.and these are two of Your helpers.

phrases.arabic: يَبْتَدِرَانِ طَاعَتَكَ بِرَحْمَة نَافِعَة أَوْ نَقِمَة ضَارَّة،
phrases.english: 3.They rush to obey You with beneficial mercy or injurious vengeance,
4.so rain not down upon us from them the evil rain
5.and clothe us not through them in the garment of affliction!
6.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,

phrases.arabic: وَأَنْزِلْ عَلَيْنَا نَفْعَ هَذِهِ السَّحَائِبِ وَبَرَكَتَهَا،
phrases.english: 7.send down upon us the benefit of these clouds and their blessing,
8.turn away from us their harm and their injury,
9.strike us not through them with blight,
10.and loose not upon our livelihoods any bane!

phrases.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ وَإنْ كُنْتَ بَعَثْتَهَا نَقِمَةً وَأَرْسَلْتَهَا سَخْطَةً
phrases.english: 11.O God, if You hast incited them as vengeance and loosed them in anger,
12.we seek sanctuary with You from Your wrath
13.and implore You in asking Your pardon!
14.So incline with wrath toward the idolaters
15.and set the millstone of Your vengeance turning upon the heretics
16.O God, take away the barrenness of our lands with Your watering,
17.dislodge the malice from our breasts with Your providing,
18.distract us not from You through other than You,

phrases.arabic: وَلاَ تَقْطَعْ عَنْ كَافَّتِنَا مَادَّةَ بِرِّكَ،
phrases.english: 19.and cut none of us off from the stuff of Your goodness,
20.for the rich is he to whom You hast given riches,
21.and the safe he whom You hast protected!
22.No one has any defense against You,
23.nor any means to bar Your penalty.

phrases.arabic: تَحْكُمُ بِمَا شِئْتَ عَلَى مَنْ شِئْتَ،
phrases.english: 24.You decidest what You wilt for whom You wilt
25.and You decreest what You desirest for any whom You desirest!

phrases.arabic: فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَلَى مَا وَقَيْتَنَا مِنَ الْبَلاءِ،
phrases.english: 26.So to You belongs praise for protecting us from affliction

phrases.arabic: وَلَكَ الشُّكْرُ عَلَى مَا خَوَّلْتَنَا مِنَ النّعْمَاءِ
phrases.english: 27.and to You belongs thanks for conferring upon us blessings,
28.a praise which will leave behind the praise of the praisers,
29.a praise which will fill the earth and the heaven!
30.Surely You art the All-kind through immense kindnesses,
31.the Giver of abounding favours,
32.the Accepter of small praise,
33.the Grateful for little gratitude,
34.the Beneficent, the Benevolent, Possessor of graciousness!

phrases.arabic: لا إلهَ إلاّ أَنْتَ إلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ.
phrases.english: 35.There is no god but Thou; unto You is the homecoming
